description: This file defines the interface for system and device power management in Zephyr OS, including notifier structures, power state control functions, and hooks for sleep states.

methods.name: pm_notifier_register
methods.description: Registers a power management notifier callback.

methods.name: pm_notifier_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a power management notifier callback.

methods.name: pm_state_next_get
methods.description: Retrieves the next power state info for a given CPU.

methods.name: pm_state_set
methods.description: Sets the processor into a specified power state.

methods.name: pm_state_exit_post_ops
methods.description: Performs post operations after exiting sleep state.
